config.name: Getting Started with LogicMonitor
config.content: New account starting point Welcome to LogicMonitor Curated for onboarding, operations, and support Build a stronger foundation for hybrid observability. Start here for the resources your team will use most while getting started with LogicMonitor. Follow the setup guides, training paths, and support links to connect your environment, tune alerts, and build operational confidence. Start the academy path → Open support center Check system status Recommended first steps Start with the essentials. 1 Plan the rollout Define owners, priority resource groups, escalation paths, and what success looks like for the first 30 days. Readiness guide Top dependencies 2 Connect the signals Deploy collectors, add cloud or SaaS accounts, and confirm resources are landing in the right groups. Add collectors Cloud monitoring NetScans 3 Tune for action Review alert thresholds, recipients, and routing so notifications are useful from the beginning. Alert thresholds Escalation chains Alert rules 4 Operationalize Use dashboards, reports, and release notes to keep teams aligned as coverage expands. Dashboard management Resource groups Essentials for day one Quick access to documentation, training, release notes, and security information. Docs, training, health, trust DSupport CenterDocs Product documentation, platform concepts, configuration guides, and operational references. Open docs → ALogicMonitor AcademyTraining Role-based learning paths for administrators, operators, and teams getting started. Start learning → RRelease NotesUpdates Track platform updates, new capabilities, and changes that may affect your rollout. View updates → TTrust CenterSecurity Security, compliance, privacy, and reliability information for governance reviews. Review trust center → Operate with confidence Continue building your LogicMonitor practice with planning guidance, community insights, and support options.
